nintendoNotes:
Official Nintendo AU data confirms Nintendo Switch release, Nintendo Switch 2 backward compatibility, 9.1 GB file size, TV/Tabletop/Handheld play, Save Data Cloud, and Simplified/Traditional Chinese among the supported languages.

Supplier selection supplied by user: Simplified Chinese. Supplier has exactly two product options, so no supplier DLC product type is created. Regular / 普通版 ¥6.8 (pre-discount ¥10); Standard / 标准版 ¥46 (pre-discount ¥50). Converted purchase costs: Regular 1,250 IQD; Standard 10,000 IQD.

Nintendo Switch 2 support is backward compatibility only; this is not a native Switch 2 edition and switch2_enhanced remains false.
switch2Features: No official Switch 2 enhancement patch advertised

gameplayPillars.title: Investigate the Midnight Channel
gameplayPillars.description: Use Personas, elemental weaknesses, buffs, debuffs and All-Out Attacks in turn-based battles against Shadows.

gameplayPillars.title: Build Social Links
gameplayPillars.description: Spend calendar days with friends, classmates and townspeople to strengthen Social Links and unlock stronger Persona fusion bonuses.

gameplayPillars.title: Master Persona Combat
gameplayPillars.description: Investigate the murder case, explore themed dungeons and gather clues as the Investigation Team pursues the truth.

gameplayPillars.title: Fuse and Customize Personas
gameplayPillars.description: Collect and fuse Personas to build coverage for elemental weaknesses, support skills and boss strategies.

worldSummary: Inaba is a quiet rural Japanese town whose ordinary school life is disrupted by a serial murder case and a supernatural world accessed through television screens. The contrast between everyday friendships and dangerous fog-filled dungeons drives the game’s mystery.

storyChapters.title: Arrival in Inaba
storyChapters.body: The protagonist moves to Inaba and soon discovers that a strange television world may be connected to recent murders.

storyChapters.title: The Investigation Team
storyChapters.body: A group of students forms the Investigation Team, entering the TV World to rescue victims and confront Shadows.

storyChapters.title: The Search for the Truth
storyChapters.body: As months pass, the team builds relationships, uncovers new suspects and moves closer to the truth behind the Midnight Channel.

storyChapters.title: The Final Truth
storyChapters.body: Late-game revelations challenge the Investigation Team to separate convenient answers from the real truth behind Inaba’s supernatural events.

faq.q: Does Persona 4 Golden support Simplified Chinese on Switch?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese among the supported Switch languages.

faq.q: Does Persona 4 Golden work on Nintendo Switch 2?
faq.a: Yes. Nintendo lists Nintendo Switch 2 compatibility as supported, but the game remains the Switch version running through backward compatibility.
No. The game is primarily single-player. Nintendo lists online-supported functions, but they are not competitive or cooperative multiplayer.

faq.q: Does the supplier listing include a DLC product option?
faq.a: No. The supplier data contains only Regular / 普通版 and Standard / 标准版. Under the store extraction rule, this creates only Offline Standard and Online Standard product types.
